entries.title: When LLM Gateways Go Wrong: Findings from LiteLLM
entries.description: As LLM gateways see wider adoption, understanding the security risks they introduce is essential to deploying them safely within an AI stack. These systems sit between applications and model providers and often handle credentials, configuration, and request routing. We decided to take a closer look at LiteLLM, one of the most popular LLM gateways in use today. entries.title: Behind the tags: How Elastic SIEM grades 1,781 detection rules on noise, speed, and threat coverage
entries.description: This article explains how Elastic SIEM uses a monthly automated telemetry pipeline to score prebuilt detection rules across noise, performance, threat, and profile dimensions, helping security teams decide which rules to enable first.
